articles.title: How Texas’ Blue Takeover Could Soon Begin Impacting Texans’ Lives
articles.summary: Texas has long been led by Republicans, from its governor’s mansion and state legislature down to many of its locally held offices. But this year’s elections have abruptly turned the ruby-red state blue , with sweeping implications for Texas’ laws and the lives of its more than 30 million residents. Democrats scored a series of historic victories in Texas state politics earlier this month, winning every statewide race on the ballot and a number of more local contests to boot. articles.title: What An Early Polar Vortex Combined With El Niño Means For Winter Weather
articles.summary: A record-early breakdown of the polar vortex is expected to bring cold weather to the United States by the end of the month. The expected wobble in the polar vortex that sends Arctic temperatures south, however, could be in competition with the strong El Niño forecast for this winter —but experts say that how it will impact our weather remains to be seen. articles.title: Microsoft Struggles to Repair Worldwide Outage. Here's What You Need to Know
articles.summary: An outage affecting Microsoft services including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot has stretched into a second day, leaving businesses and governments around the world struggling to access email communications. As of Friday midday ET, almost 24 hours since the outage was first reported, Microsoft said it was observing "signs of sustained recovery" across its services, with email queues "approaching normal levels." articles.title: Why BMI Is Not the Best Measure of Health
articles.summary: BMI, or body mass index, has long been a part of health evaluations. A calculation that takes into account a person’s weight and height, BMI is supposed to reflect how much excess fat a person might be carrying and give doctors a sense of a patient's risk for obesity-related health conditions. For years, however, doctors have found that BMI isn’t the best measure of obesity-related health, since it can’t distinguish between fat and muscle weight.
